review.finding: The installed checkpoint directory entry needs its own fsync after rename.

contract.pre_rename_failure: E_IO preserves all prior checkpoint bytes and leaves the resident agent unchanged.
contract.post_rename_failure: Directory fsync or close failure returns E_IO; the replacement is already installed.
contract.errors: The first failed operation errno is preserved through descriptor and temporary-file cleanup.

dependency.role: Existing ordinary notorch object supplies the linked engine; this save-only gate does not execute sentence perception.
